in_sanskrit.name: मूर्मि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who produces a murmuring or whispering sound.

in_hindi.name: मूर्मि
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who murmurs or whispers.

in_tamil.name: மூர்மி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one with a low voice or who speaks in hushed tones.

in_telugu.name: మూర్మి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who murmurs or whispers.

in_marathi.name: Murmu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sound of the cosmic energy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murmu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Murmu is the primal sound of the cosmic energy, OM. It is considered the vibration of the universe, and chanting it is believed to bring inner peace and harmony.
